journeys.name: Career Evidence Onboarding
journeys.success_signal: candidate understands provenance/evidence/attestation distinctions without manually rebuilding a CV

journeys.name: Daily Shortlist
journeys.success_signal: executive can identify worthwhile attention without reading a dashboard or large job list

journeys.name: Explore to Pursue
journeys.success_signal: user understands difference between interesting and worth serious career/network investment

journeys.name: Pursuit Recommendation
journeys.success_signal: user trusts recommendation because reasons, concerns, unknowns, confidence and evidence are visible

journeys.name: Access Plan
journeys.success_signal: user sees a credible route beyond direct apply without confusing relationship fact and recommendation

journeys.name: Evidence Binding
journeys.success_signal: user can bind relevant career evidence to a mandate and understands downstream reuse

journeys.name: Browser Capture
journeys.success_signal: untrusted page becomes structured candidate data without page-derived authority

journeys.name: Recruiter or Interview Debrief
journeys.success_signal: candidate can turn a short debrief into reviewable intelligence without silently rewriting known facts

journeys.name: Offer Decision
journeys.success_signal: candidate sees financial and career tradeoffs while preserving explicit human decision authority

journeys.name: Career Strategy Review
journeys.success_signal: candidate can distinguish preliminary signal from tested strategy conclusion
